column1: # Lobe-sector phantom (project new_with_slices): copies of the v2 Normal design with gray/white matter cut into six
# 60-degree lobe sectors S1..S6 centred on antennas T1..T6. One solve per design and stop rule. See MODEL_CARD Part 5.
# Mesh/stop rule from the HFSS convergence tables (user
# deterministic (same rule -> identical passes). stop_rule: 1 = first pass with dS < 0.02; 2 = two consecutive passes.
# The file suffix _c3 is only the user's label
#   lobe_A = stop rule 1 (PRIMARY): the four stages + LeftOnly_test_c3 and MCI_lobe_c3 (both 6 passes
#   lobe_B = stop rule 2: the four stages; lobe_tests = Healthy_sliced_new + the two test designs (QC / scoring only).
# kind: stage = a staging design (used by scripts/07_lobe.py); test = pre-registered test design (scripts/09_lobe_tests.py).
#   LeftOnly_test is listed as class Mild and MCI_lobe as class MCI only because the loader needs a stage label.
# DUPLICATES not listed: new_with_slices_Moderate_lobe_new.s6p and new_with_slices_Severe_lobe_new.s6p were re-solved with
#   rule 1 and equal Moderate_lobe / Severe_lobe to ~1e-8 (deterministic meshing).
